attempt_history.llm_sketch:
workflow_id: sent-email-history-ingestion

steps:
  - id: retrieve_sent_emails
    op: gmail/list_messages
    params:
      account: club-gmail
      folder: sent
      date_range:
        from: "-1 month"
        to: "-2 weeks"
      include_fields:
        - messageId
        - subject
        - date
        - recipient
        - body
    output: raw_sent_emails

  - id: filter_short_emails
    op: collection/filter
    params:
      input: "{{raw_sent_emails}}"
      condition: "item.body != null AND length(item.body) >= 20"
    output: filtered_emails

  - id: build_and_chunk
    op: text/chunk
    params:
      input: "{{filtered_emails}}"
      template: |
        Subject: {{item.subject}}
        Date: {{item.date}}
        Recipient: {{item.recipient}}
        Body: {{item.body}}
      chunk_size: 500
      chunk_overlap: 50
      chunk_id_pattern: "sent-{{item.messageId}}-chunk-{{chunk_index}}"
    output: text_chunks

  - id: embed_chunks
    op: embedding/generate
    params:
      input: "{{text_chunks}}"
      model: embedding-model
      text_field: chunk_text
    output: embedded_chunks

  - id: insert_into_vector_store
    op: vectorstore/upsert
    params:
      input: "{{embedded_chunks}}"
      namespace: email-history
      id_field: chunk_id
      vector_field: embedding
      metadata_fields:
        - messageId
        - subject
        - date
        - recipient
        - chunk_index
        - chunk_text
